method: Each image thumbnailed to 360 px long side (Lanczos), sRGB->CIELAB (D65), k-means++ k=6, 4 attempts, <=40 iterations, seed 7. hex = median pixel of the cluster (a colour that actually occurs); hex_mean = cluster mean; lab = cluster centroid; hue_band from the centroid hue angle (neutral if chroma <= 8). Pooled palettes use 200 px thumbnails.
script: scratchpad tools/illustration/palettes.py (not shipped in the library)
